title: Simplicity vs Scalability
subtitle: Build for the load you can measure, and know the number at which you will split
motto: Complexity you build today is paid for with time you do not have
keyInsight: Scaling machinery built before users need it costs months and money now for capacity used much later, so start simple and choose the load at which you will split.

decisions.title: Price the head start in dollars and months
decisions.description: The microservices frame reports build cost and launch time against the monolith, so complexity appears as money spent before revenue.
decisions.alternatives: Describing microservices as 'more complex' would not show what the complexity costs a small team.

decisions.title: Output months until the wall
decisions.description: Every frame shows how long current growth takes to reach 70% of capacity, which turns 'we might need to scale' into a date.
decisions.alternatives: A fixed rule such as 'use a monolith below 10 engineers' would ignore growth.
